text:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike detected in external action/agent execs -> queue depth 8k, 95th p90 latency up 4x, error rate 12% on prod-cluster-3. auto-mitigation suggestions: restrict tool execs, throttle by plan, disable structured output for streaming routes 

sophia: paging oncall (I have the page). seeing customer-facing errors for some tenants, looks correlated w/ fncall-heavy workloads. starting mitigation checklist. 

eli: +1. recommend immediate partial disable of external tool invocation for free-tier + soft-throttle for paid tiers. keep hosted API text-only fallback where possible. 

sophia: action: flip feature flag `tool_exec.allow` -> false for plan=free, set `action_exec.rate_limit`=20r/s per-tenant for standard. will do via ops console unless runtime objections. 

sanjay: risky for long-running jobs, but acceptable as short-term. watch for cached KV eviction impact. i'll standby to open rollback if latency for sync text gen rises. 

ops-bot: runbook step executed: `rb apply --env=prod --patch '{"featureFlags": {"tool_exec.allow": {"free": false}}}'` — change ID ff-20260317-01. triggered config rollout to cluster group a/b. 

matt: noted. also trimming structured-output responses on streaming endpoints: set `structured_json.enabled=false` for route `/v1/chat/stream`. this reduces downstream parse work. 

lina: support ping — which tenants are most impacted? we need a short customer blurb. 

eli: top offenders: tenant ids t-231, t-542, t-812. t-231 is using agent orchestration flow, t-542 heavy tool chaining. 

sophia: customer comm draft: "We're experiencing elevated errors for tool-invoking requests. We've temporarily restricted external tool executions for free plans and applied per-tenant throttles for paid plans to protect service stability. If you rely on agent/tool flows, please contact support for a targeted exception." feedback? 

lina: good. add estimated time horizon: 1-2 hours for mitigation, will update if extends. also include support contact link. 

sanjay: after feature flag rollout, monitor queue depth and p90; also enable temporary KV-cache TTL increase to 6h to reduce re-compute load. I'll apply that. 

ops-bot: telemetry note: mitigation ff-20260317-01 applied at 2026-03-17T14:02:10Z. throttle policy p-20260317-02 set: action_exec default=20r/s, burst=40, global cap=10k r/s. 

incident-bot: INCIDENT: oncall handoff scheduled — sophia will maintain lead for 30m then hand to sanjay for runtime deep-dive. pager rotation updated. 

matt: quick check — make sure functioncall sandboxing still permits internal platform agent health checks; exclude `platform-check` service from throttles. 

eli: excluded `platform-check` and `health-probe` services from rate limits. 

sophia: handing over to sanjay now for runtime adjustments and rollback guard. leaving notes in incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/INC-20260317-toolgate. 

sanjay: taking over. next steps: run perf profile on worker nodes, validate KV TTL change, watch for cold-start token spikes. if error rate <2% and latency within 1.5x baseline, begin gradual re-enable plan for paid tiers. 

lina: support will send the comm now and post status update to status.redwood.ai. 

incident-bot: RESOLVED ACTION: initial mitigation in place. monitor channel for updates. close page if no regressions after 45m. :white_check_mark:
